rites.name: Surataleno
rites.text: Surataleno is the resonance that first gathered the roots of Oriilora out of silence during the Singing, a concept that exists only as a pitch the early world hummed toward. Its presence hardened loose potential into the first stable bonds, letting the nascent world hold its shape.

rites.name: Savseth
rites.text: Savseth is a concept in Oriilora's Arcane Realm, belonging to the Courts of the second era, when divine trials and councils shaped the doors between worlds. It is remembered as the principle by which a single act of judgment could sever or join entire planes of existence. Its scholars treat it as a measure of how much a court can bear when the doors are being built.

rites.name: Corantolor
rites.text: Corantolor is a concept of Oriilora, the spiral of thresholds that the Courts of the Arcane Realm have never fully agreed upon. Its first age is remembered as a season of divine trials, when councils argued over which powers might pass through the doors being raised between worlds.

rites.name: Mianneth
rites.text: Mianneth is a concept of Oriilora's Arcane Realm, imagined as the quiet force the makers planted into the Weave during the Seeding, when latent powers were laid to sleep. Its character is that of a dormant pattern waiting for a bond to wake it, and it is remembered mainly through the Age of Sundering that followed landfall.

rites.name: Shivsora
rites.text: Shivsora is the concept of the Oriilora's sovereign-binding force, held in the Arcane Realm during the Fall, when worlds sundered and the Pact was sworn. It is the living thread by which the first sovereign's groves and growing kingdoms were kept whole against the breaking of the Shards.

rites.name: Vintellum
rites.text: Vintellum is a concept of the Arcane Realm in Oriilora, a binding-force that the orders of the Holy Age taught as the thread holding shattered worlds to the Pact. Its wardens believed that a single sworn word could steady a falling sky, though the Sundering proved how fragile such oaths could be.

rites.name: Silanae
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Luminara, entities known as Eidolons undergo 'Evanescence' when their essence becomes too chaotic. Post-Evanescence, they're housed in the Serenity Sanctum, a place of tranquility and interaction.
